body.title: Add IndexQueue.depthForRepo read accessor (src/daemon/queue.ts)
body.summary: Add a read-only depthForRepo(repoPath): number method to IndexQueue that counts currently-queued IndexJobs attributable to repoPath — jobs whose repoPath===repoPath (full/reembed/doc-summarise-repo) or whose filePath is under repoPath+sep (file/config-file). The private queue array is NOT exposed and the existing get depth() is unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: depthForRepo counts full/reembed/doc-summarise-repo jobs by repoPath and file/config-file jobs by filePath-under-repo; unrelated/global jobs are not counted; returns 0 for a repo with no jobs
the private IndexJob[] stays private (no new getter exposing it) and get depth() is byte-unchanged

tests.name: IndexQueue.depthForRepo: a full/reembed/doc-summarise-repo job with repoPath===R counts toward R; a file/config-file job whose filePath is under R+sep counts toward R

IndexQueue.depthForRepo: a job for another repo (or a global config-full) does NOT count toward R; returns 0 for a repo with no queued jobs; get depth() unchanged and the private jobs array not exposed
